metadata.author: Peut-Etre Theatre
metadata.description:
Audiomoves is an award-winning podcast for children aged 4+ who love to move.

Perfect for curious kids, parents, and teachers, each series encourages listeners to move creatively, and explore big ideas through their bodies and imagination.

Whether blasting off with Audiomoves in Space, going wild with Audiomoves at the zoo, or winding down with Audiomoves goes to Sleep, the podcast combines children’s questions, answered by experts, with guided movement adventures that bring learning to life.

🏆 Winner of the British Podcast Award 2023 (Silver - Best Kids Show)
✨ Featured in The Guardian's 20 best podcasts for children, 'A gorgeous digital series'
